ቅብጥ: ቅብጥ — the Copts, Egypt (proper name, collective)
እመንበረ: መንበር — from the throne of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ሀገረ: ሀገር — city, country (noun; construct 'city of') · accusative 'the city' as object of አዖድዎ ('they led him around the city') · accusative of place 'in the city' (ይነብር ሀገረ 'he would stay in the city')
በመዋዕለ: መዋዕል — in the days of (በ- + plural of ዕለት, construct)
ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
መስቀል: መስቀል — cross (noun; genitive after the construct ዕፀ)
ጳጳስ: ጳጳስ — bishop (noun, singular; in apposition to ጎርጎርዮስ)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53) · ነገረ — he spoke, said (3ms perfect, G, n-g-r; ነገረ እንዘ ይብል 'he spoke, saying')
ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
ኀለይኩ: ኀለየ — I thought, pondered (1sg perfect, ḫ-l-y)
ወፅአት: ወጽአ — she went out (3fs perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
ትብል: ብህለ — she says (3fs imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 2ms 'you say' (ሶበ ጸብሐ ትብል 'when it is morning you say')
እለሰ: እለ — those, indeed (relative pronoun pl. + enclitic -ሰ)
ኢኮኑ: ኮነ — they were not (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, k-w-n)
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ተዐድዎ: ተዐደወ — transgressing, overstepping (verbal noun of ተዐደወ; the final -ዎ is the verbal-noun ending, not 'his')
ሕግ: ሕግ — law (noun) · collective 'laws' after a plural demonstrative (ለእሉ ሕግ ወአስማት 'these laws and names')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
በመንግሥተ: መንግሥት — in the kingdom of (በ- + noun, construct)
ወተረክበት: ተረክበ — and she was found (ወ- + 3fs perfect, passive of ረከበ)
ላዕሌየ: ላዕለ — upon me, against me (preposition ላዕለ + -የ '1cs me', ላዕሌየ)
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, much (adjective, masc. sg., accusative)
ክብራ: ክብር — her glory (noun + -ሃ 'her', anticipating ለጽዮን 'of Zion'; not a construct)
ለሀገረ: ሀገር — for the city of, over the city of (ለ- + noun, construct) · object-marking ለ- (ወያውዕይዋ ለሀገረ ሰዶም 'and that they burn the city of Sodom')
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us') · accusative object 'a king' (ወለደት ሰማያዊ ንጉሠ 'she bore a heavenly king')
አነሂ: አነ — I also, I too (1s independent pronoun + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
ርቱዕ: ርቱዕ — right, fitting (adjective, used as predicate) · predicate before a subjunctive, 'it is right that' (ርቱዕ ንስግድ 'it is right that we bow')
ፍቁረ: ፍቁር — the Beloved (passive participle of ፈቀረ, accusative; object of ረሰየ)
ወአፍቀረ: አፍቀረ — and he loved (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative)
ወይቤለኒ: ይቤ — and he said to me (ወ- + 3ms perfect + ለ- 'to' + -ኒ '1cs me')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
ምስሌየ: ምስለ — with me (preposition, stem ምስሌ- + -የ '1cs me')
ተመንደብነ: ተመንደበ — we were afflicted, distressed (?) (1cp perfect, quadriliteral tä-stem; meaning from context) (?)
ፈድፋደ: ፈድፋደ — exceedingly, greatly (adverb) · 'especially' before a numeral (ፈድፋደ ፯ እምኔሆሙ 'especially seven of them') (?)
አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
ወሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — and the people of (ወ- + noun, accusative/construct 'people of')
ወመሓሪ: መሓሪ — merciful, one who forgives (active participle, masc. sg.; ወ- 'and')
ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55) · 'all those' as antecedent of the relative እለ (እምነ ኵሎሙ እለ ፈጠረ 'above (?) all those whom he created')
ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies') · adjective 'holy', plural, before or after a noun (ቅዱሳን ካህናት 'holy priests'; ለሐዋርያቲሁ ቅዱሳን 'to his holy apostles')
ወሰማዕት: ሰማዕት — and martyrs, witnesses (ወ- + noun ሰማዕት, read as plural) (?)
ይጽሐፍ: ጸሐፈ — let him write (3ms jussive, G, ṣ-ḥ-f)
መጽሐፈ: መጽሐፍ — a book (noun, accusative) · construct 'book of' (መጽሐፈ ሕግ 'the book of the law', ch. 55)
ለዓለመ: ዓለም — age, world, eternity (noun, construct state 'age-of'; ለ- 'for')
ባሕረ: ባሕር — sea (noun, accusative of place 'by sea') · accusative object or goal: 'reached the sea' (ወበጽሑ ባሕረ), 'crossed the sea' (ዐደዉ ባሕረ), 'came out of the sea' (ወወፅኡ ባሕረ), ch. 55 · construct 'sea of' (ባሕረ ኢርትራ 'the Sea of Erythra, the Red Sea')
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
አኀው: አኅ — brothers (plural of አኅ, አኀው) · siblings, brother and sister together (፪ አኀው 'two siblings')
ካሌብ: ካሌብ — Caleb (proper name; king of Ethiopia)
ሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adj.) · 'good' as a substantive (ዘይረክበከ ሠናይ 'what good will find you')
ሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — people (noun; predicate accusative) · people of (construct, ሕዝበ እግዚኣብሔር 'people of God', ሕዝበ እስራኤል 'people of Israel') · accusative in apposition to መንታ: ክልኤተ ሕዝበ 'two peoples' (the twins as heads of lines) (?) · or construct 'the two peoples of Perez and Zerah' (ክልኤተ ሕዝበ ፋሬስ ወዛራ) (?)
ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
ተሀይደ: ተሀይደ — he/it was taken away (3ms perfect passive; uncertain stem)
ለሕዝብ: ሕዝብ — to a people (ለ- + noun) · 'for the people' after a verb (አስተሰረየ ለሕዝብ 'made atonement for the people')
እምነገደ: ነገድ — from the tribe of (እም- + noun, construct)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God') · 'god' in ዘእምአምላክ 'that is from god' (no article)
ቅድመ: ቅድመ — before (preposition, construct) · adverbial 'forward' (ቅድመ ወድኅረ 'forward and back')
